figures.name: fig1_radiation_sweep
figures.caption: Coupled radiation coefficients of the tilted submerged section from the in-house BEM sweep (48 panels, adaptively refined). The cross coefficient is large and negative, which is what makes the case a genuine matrix problem.

figures.name: fig2_kernel_matrix
figures.caption: Normalised memory kernel matrix K_ij(tau). Each entry opens with its K_ij(0+) jump and falls inside the 0.5% band (dashed) before the truncation time (dotted).

figures.name: fig3_harmonic_closure
figures.caption: Time-domain convolution (solid) against the frequency-domain radiation force (dashed) for both degrees of freedom under a two-mode prescribed motion.

figures.name: fig4_free_decay
figures.caption: Free decay of the coupled Cummins equation (left) and its envelope against the frequency-domain damping ratios (right).

figures.name: fig5_error_envelope
figures.caption: Error envelope of the constant-coefficient substitute against omega_p/omega_n; dashed lines are the 5% and 10 deg acceptance bands.
